name: ZN NFP vs CPI Intraday Reaction
description: Compares ZN 10-year note intraday reaction to NFP vs CPI releases at 8:30 AM ET. Measures average absolute price move at 5, 15, and 30 minutes post-release. No regime splits — all NFP days treated as one group, all CPI days as another. Dashboard: summary table (NFP vs CPI rows × 5/15/30-min avg |move| + count), grouped bar chart, and event markers for each release.
source:
# =============================================================================
# ZN 10-YEAR NOTE: NFP vs CPI INTRADAY REACTION COMPARISON
# =============================================================================
# Both NFP and CPI release at 8:30 AM ET.
# No regime splits — all NFP days as one group, all CPI days as another.
# Measures avg absolute move at 5, 15, and 30 minutes post-release.
# =============================================================================

# === DATA SOURCE (1Min bars) ===
src = market_data_source()()

# === CONTINUOUS CONTRACT ===
cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment, i_offset=0)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
close = cont.c
high = cont.h
low = cont.l
open_price = cont.o

# === CPI DAY DETECTION ===
cpi_data = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.CPI)()
cpi_value = cpi_data.result
cpi_filled = ffill_day(cpi_value)
is_cpi_day = is_valid(cpi_filled)

# === NFP DAY DETECTION ===
nfp_data = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.NonfarmPayrolls)()
nfp_value = nfp_data.result
nfp_filled = ffill_day(nfp_value)
is_nfp_day_raw = is_valid(nfp_filled)

# NFP releases on Fridays — filter to avoid false positives from revisions
bar_idx = index()
day_of_week = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.day_of_week)(bar_idx)
is_friday = day_of_week == 4
is_nfp_day = is_nfp_day_raw and is_friday

# === SESSION WINDOWS (5, 15, 30 minutes post-release) ===

# 5-min window: 08:30-08:35
w_5m = session_window(session=Session(start='08:30', end='08:35', tz='America/New_York'))(open_price, high, low, close)

# 15-min window: 08:30-08:45
w_15m = session_window(session=Session(start='08:30', end='08:45', tz='America/New_York'))(open_price, high, low, close)

# 30-min window: 08:30-09:00
w_30m = session_window(session=Session(start='08:30', end='09:00', tz='America/New_York'))(open_price, high, low, close)

# === WINDOW RETURNS ===
r_5m = ((w_5m.close - w_5m.open) / w_5m.open) if w_5m.closed else 0
r_15m = ((w_15m.close - w_15m.open) / w_15m.open) if w_15m.closed else 0
r_30m = ((w_30m.close - w_30m.open) / w_30m.open) if w_30m.closed else 0

# === LATCH SHORTER WINDOWS TO 30-MIN CLOSE FOR ALIGNMENT ===
ret_5m_latched = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(w_5m.closed, r_5m)
ret_15m_latched = valuewhen(occurrence=0)(w_15m.closed, r_15m)

# === NFP ALIGNED SERIES (absolute moves) ===
nfp_abs_5m = where(w_30m.closed and is_nfp_day, abs(ret_5m_latched))
nfp_abs_15m = where(w_30m.closed and is_nfp_day, abs(ret_15m_latched))
nfp_abs_30m = where(w_30m.closed and is_nfp_day, abs(r_30m))

# === CPI ALIGNED SERIES (absolute moves) ===
cpi_abs_5m = where(w_30m.closed and is_cpi_day, abs(ret_5m_latched))
cpi_abs_15m = where(w_30m.closed and is_cpi_day, abs(ret_15m_latched))
cpi_abs_30m = where(w_30m.closed and is_cpi_day, abs(r_30m))

# === COUNTERS ===
nfp_count = where(w_30m.closed and is_nfp_day, 1.0)
cpi_count = where(w_30m.closed and is_cpi_day, 1.0)

# === EVENT MARKER HELPERS (signed returns for detail) ===
nfp_em_5m = where(w_30m.closed and is_nfp_day, ret_5m_latched)
nfp_em_15m = where(w_30m.closed and is_nfp_day, ret_15m_latched)
nfp_em_30m = where(w_30m.closed and is_nfp_day, r_30m)

cpi_em_5m = where(w_30m.closed and is_cpi_day, ret_5m_latched)
cpi_em_15m = where(w_30m.closed and is_cpi_day, ret_15m_latched)
cpi_em_30m = where(w_30m.closed and is_cpi_day, r_30m)

# =============================================================================
# REPORTS
# =============================================================================

# --- Summary Table: NFP vs CPI, Avg |Move| at 5/15/30 min + Event Count ---
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='ZN Avg Absolute Move: NFP vs CPI (8:30 AM ET Release)',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['NFP', 'CPI'],
        col_headers=['Avg |Move| 5min', 'Avg |Move| 15min', 'Avg |Move| 30min', 'Event Count'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Blue),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, grid_color=Color.Blue)
        ]
    ),
    category='NFP vs CPI',
    order=0
)(nfp_abs_5m, nfp_abs_15m, nfp_abs_30m, nfp_count, cpi_abs_5m, cpi_abs_15m, cpi_abs_30m, cpi_count)

# --- Grouped Bar Chart: NFP vs CPI Avg |Move| by Interval ---
xy_bars(
    title='ZN Avg Absolute Move by Interval: NFP vs CPI',
    category='NFP vs CPI',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    y_axis_label='Avg |Move|',
    order=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='NFP', color=Color.Blue, stack='5-Min'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='CPI', color=Color.Slate, stack='5-Min'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='NFP', color=Color.Blue, stack='15-Min'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='CPI', color=Color.Slate, stack='15-Min'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='NFP', color=Color.Blue, stack='30-Min'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='CPI', color=Color.Slate, stack='30-Min')
    ])
)(nfp_abs_5m, cpi_abs_5m, nfp_abs_15m, cpi_abs_15m, nfp_abs_30m, cpi_abs_30m)

# --- Event Markers: NFP Releases ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='NFP Release',
        icon=Icon.BellRingIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='5-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='15-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='30-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    )
)(w_30m.closed and is_nfp_day, nfp_em_5m, nfp_em_15m, nfp_em_30m)

# --- Event Markers: CPI Releases ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='CPI Release',
        icon=Icon.BarChart2Icon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='5-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='15-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='30-Min Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    )
)(w_30m.closed and is_cpi_day, cpi_em_5m, cpi_em_15m, cpi_em_30m)
